caption:
SPINACH RICOTTA CANNELLONI 🍝

The kind of dinner that feels like a warm hug but still fits into your everyday eating 🥹

Creamy spinach & ricotta filling, rolled into cannelloni, covered in tomato sauce, topped with cheese and baked until golden and bubbly.

Serves 3

INGREDIENTS
• Cannelloni tubes
• Ricotta
• Spinach
• Tomato pasta sauce
• Mozzarella
• Garlic
• Italian seasoning
• Salt & pepper
• Chilli flakes

METHOD

1. Wilt the spinach with garlic and let it cool slightly.
2. Mix with ricotta, seasoning, salt, pepper and chilli flakes.
3. Boil the cannelloni according to the packet instructions, then drain carefully.
4. Fill the cannelloni with the spinach-ricotta mixture.
5. Add a layer of tomato sauce to a baking dish and arrange the cannelloni on top.
6. Cover with more sauce and mozzarella.
7. Bake until golden, bubbly and delicious.

PRO TIP: I recommend boiling the pasta beforehand — it’s the best way to make sure your cannelloni are perfectly cooked and never hard or raw after baking. 👌🏼
